name: imagine-studio-new-ui
description: Imagine Studio — new UI build (revamped interface over the original app logic)

scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');fs.mkdirSync(path.join(__dirname,'dist'),{recursive:true});for(const f of ['app.js','server.js','index.html','styles.css','three-bg.js','revamp.js','landing.html','landing.css','landing.js'])fs.copyFileSync(path.join(__dirname,f),path.join(__dirname,'dist',f));fs.mkdirSync(path.join(__dirname,'dist','vendor'),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'vendor','three-0.160.0.min.js'),path.join(__dirname,'dist','vendor','three-0.160.0.min.js'));console.log('[prebuild] synced sources to dist/')"
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && pkg --targets node18-win-x64 --config pkg.config.json --output dist/imagine-studio-new-ui.exe server.js
